description: T-4164: how Excel for the web orders ties, errors and blanks when a pivot field is sorted by a value. Data!A1:C9 has Product, Year and Sales: Kiwi 2024 10, Kiwi 2025 20, Fig 2025 30, Plum 2024 5, Plum 2025 25, Apple 2024 50, Date 2024 -1, Date 2025 21. Product sums Kiwi 30, Fig 30, Plum 30 (a three-way tie: cache order Kiwi, Fig, Plum; alphabetical Fig, Kiwi, Plum), Apple 50, Date 20; for 2024 Kiwi 10, Fig blank (no record), Plum 5, Apple 50, Date -1; for 2025 Kiwi 20, Fig 30, Plum 25, Apple blank, Date 21. Each sheet is one builder-v2 pivot at A3, rows Product, Sum of Sales, sorted by the data field (autoSortScope): STd descending; STa ascending; STo descending with the field's `<item>` elements in the order Fig, Date, Plum, Apple, Kiwi (`item_order`; the cache keeps Kiwi, Fig, Plum, Apple, Date); STc and STca descending and ascending with the cache, and the items with it, written Plum, Fig, Kiwi, Apple, Date (`order`; the source order is still Kiwi, Fig, Plum); SCd and SCa descending and ascending by the 2024 column (columns Year, the scope's second reference Year item 0); SC2 descending by the 2025 column (Year item 1). Err!A1:B6 has Item and Amt A 5, B =NA(), C 9, D blank, E 2: SEd and SEa rows Item, Sum of Amt, descending and ascending by value. Pivot cells are in the sidecar's `pivots` section; Q!A1 makes the case scored.
